# Tasks: `scalar()` must not read a trailing space as a value (#612)

## Review Workload Forecast

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Estimated changed lines | ~15-20 production lines (`**/*.test.mjs` and `openspec/**` are on `governance.ignoreList`, so the 6 modified/created test files are NOT counted toward review budget) |
| 400-line budget risk | Low |
| Chained PRs recommended | No |
| Suggested split | Single PR |
| Delivery strategy | ask-on-risk |
| Chain strategy | pending |

Decision needed before apply: No
Chained PRs recommended: No
Chain strategy: pending
400-line budget risk: Low

The counted reviewable diff is effectively the one-line regex repair plus JSDoc in
`yaml-block.mjs`, and a small comment removal in `parse-verdict.mjs`. Everything else
(test files) is governance-ignored. No chaining needed.

### Suggested Work Units

| Unit | Goal | Likely PR | Notes |
|------|------|-----------|-------|
| 1 | Full repair: regex, JSDoc, all consumer tests, F2 rewrite, drift header | PR 1 | Base `main`; rebase (not merge) past PR #695 if it has landed — unpushed branch, safe to rebase |

## Phase 1: Pre-flight

- [ ] 1.1 Run `npm test` on branch tip; confirm baseline is 3821 tests, exactly 1 failure (`#452/#478-F2`). A different baseline is stop-and-report, not fix-forward.
- [ ] 1.2 Check PR #695 status (`gh pr diff 695`). If merged to `main`, rebase this unpushed branch onto updated `main` now (safe — nothing pushed yet). If not merged, flag for whoever lands second.

## Phase 2: Core repair (RED then GREEN)

- [ ] 2.1 [RED] Create `brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.test.mjs` with the design D-A boundary table: `key: v`, `key:v`, `key:`, `key: ` → `null`, `key:\t` → `null`, `key:   \t  ` → `null`, `key: v  ` → `'v'`, CRLF `key:\r` → `null`.
- [ ] 2.2 [RED] Add the NBSP row: `key: <NBSP>v` → `null`. Required — kills axis-2 mutant `(\S.*)`→`(.*)`; without this row that mutant survives.
- [ ] 2.3 [RED] Add the trailing-trim row: `head_sha: <sha>  ` → parsed and trimmed. Required — kills axis-5 mutant (removed `.trim()`); without this row that mutant survives.
- [ ] 2.4 [GREEN] In `brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.mjs`, change `^${key}:[ \t]*(.+)$` → `^${key}:[ \t]*(\S.*)$`. Keep `[ \t]*` and `.trim()` unchanged (do not use `\s*` — it eats `\n` under `/m` and rebuilds the bug worse). Add JSDoc stating the three-state contract.

## Phase 3: Consumer pins (no consumer code changes)

- [ ] 3.1 Rewrite `#452/#478-F2` in `parse-verdict.test.mjs:331` in place per design D-D — same id and comment trail, assertion inverted to `findings: ` + entries now parsing. Add the nothing-follows row (`findings: ` alone → `[]`) and axis-11 invariant rows (`sequencing:`, `controls:`, `controls_not_applied:` stay `malformed`, before and after).
- [ ] 3.2 Add the six-key governance-invariance table to `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs` (design D-C, colocated with the consumer): `protocol`, `decision`, `head_sha`, `actor`, `at`, `in_reply_to` — identical admission/refusal before/after. Include `sniffDecisionProtocol('protocol: ')` → `null`, never `addressed`.
- [ ] 3.3 Add whitespace-only refusal rows to `decision-block.test.mjs` (`actor: `, `head_sha: `, `decision: `).
- [ ] 3.4 Add `track: ` → UNCLASSIFIED and `blocks: ` → `[]` rows to `epic-map.test.mjs`.
- [ ] 3.5 Add the new "missing key" error-text row to `checkpoint-block.test.mjs` for `counted_lines: `.
- [ ] 3.6 Edit `yaml-block.drift.test.mjs` header comment ONLY — one line pointing to `yaml-block.test.mjs` as the value-side contract's home. Zero assertion changes (a trailing-space row here would be `null`/`null` before and after — proves nothing, rubber-stamp trap).
- [ ] 3.7 Drop the stale "not repaired" claim in `parse-verdict.mjs:127-136`.

## Phase 4: Verification & delivery

- [ ] 4.1 Re-run `npm test`; confirm zero failures. Any failure other than the now-rewritten F2 is stop-and-report, not fix-forward.
- [ ] 4.2 Run `npm run brain:repo:check` before each commit.
- [ ] 4.3 Commit (conventional commits, no AI-attribution trailer), reference #612; open PR noting the #695 rebase relationship in the description.
